messages:
Maya: Heads up — we had a 30m alert storm from alertmanager in eu-west1 around 08:10. Looks like the blackbox probes spiked and generated many firing alerts. Investigating now.
Oliver: saw that, was it the streaming handshake probe? I saw lots of 503s but only for probe traffic.
Maya: yeah, streaming and embeddings probes both, but embeddings were the noisier ones. The probe rate is 1 req / 2s per region right now.
Kevin: that's aggressive — multiplied by 6 regions and 100 probes each... no wonder alert volume exploded.
alertmanager: [alertmanager] 3 silences suppressed 42 notifications for group=blackbox_probe_errors
Maya: alertmanager shows a bunch of dedup/silences but paging still happened due to fast re-fires.
Anita: i think it's frequency aliasing with our SLO windows. current alert rule uses increase() on a 5m window with for:1m. rapid probe bursts can flip that fast.
Oliver: can you paste the alert rule?
Maya: sure:

```
- alert: BlackboxProbeHighErrorRate
  expr: increase(blackbox_probe_errors_total{job=\"blackbox\"}[5m]) / increase(blackbox_probe_total{job=\"blackbox\"}[5m]) > 0.03
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

Maya: when probes run at 0.5s cadence, increase() jumps and we get flapping.
Kevin: suggested tweak: use rate() or a histogram_quantile over a latency histogram, plus bump for: to 5m and add \"absent_over_time\" guard for flapping. Also consider recording rule to smooth.
Anita: agree. proposal:
- change expr to use rate(blackbox_probe_errors_total[10m]) / rate(blackbox_probe_total[10m])
- set for: 5m
- add annotation: runbook link
- add label: paging-mode: gradual
Oliver: Also we should reduce probe frequency for embeddings to 1 per 15s in low-traffic regions. That reduces cost and noise.
Maya: cost note: current cross-region probes cost ~0.9k requests/day * 0.0003$/req ~ $270/month just for probes across regions. If we reduce freq that's non-trivial.
Kevin: we can also move some checks to synthetic client-side checks (long-lived) instead of blackbox for short-lived handshakes. That lowers cluster egress and GPU warmup churn.
Maya: i'm going to open a quick PR with alert rule changes + k8s config to scale probe-sampler down in eu-west1 and ap-south. will test in staging first.
Oliver: remove paging label for the rule until we validate.
Anita: I'll update the SLO dashboard panels: switch error-rate chart to a smoothed 10m moving avg and add a panel for probe QPS so we can correlate.
Maya: action items: @Oliver tweak sampling, @Anita update dash, @Kevin implement recording rule, @Maya open PR and run canary. ETA today EOD?
Oliver: yes, can do canary tonight UTC.
alertmanager: [alertmanager] silence created by Maya for BlackboxProbeHighErrorRate, duration 6h
Maya: thanks. will post results here after canary.
Kevin: +1
Anita: :thumbsup: 
Maya: closing loop — early results look good, alert noise dropped 95% in staging after rate() + for:5m. will roll to prod in 30m.
